purpose: Development test of Slow-Part Handover: can the teacher hand over before Step 4 by passing only the part of its estimate the student uses, and stopping when that part has settled

algorithm.split: on generated frames: voice = per-band mean over time; slow = centred 9-frame moving average of the remainder, edge padded; fine = the rest (sh.decompose, as in EXP-020)
algorithm.stop_rule: the first k in [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] with d_slow_k <= lambda hands over x = voice(S) + slow(T_k) + fine(S) (code STS); otherwise Step 8 whole, as the 0.25 reference
algorithm.draft: S = eps + g(eps, 0), one student pass from independent noise (seed + 1009), made only at handover
algorithm.student: the released student loop at j = 1 from x

data.quality: the EXP-012 Quick set: first 60 development speakers x ['clean', 'noisy15', 'gauss18', 'gauss20', 'gauss22', 'gauss25'] (360 cases)
data.diversity: the first 20 development speakers x ['clean', 'noisy15'], 20 seeds (input_seed + 1000 + m), outputs ['STS_2', 'STS_3', 'STS_4', 'plain_8']
data.reused: plain Steps 1-8 (EXP-018), student only (EXP-017) and Voice-Swap STT_4 (EXP-020), same seeds and T4

hardware: Colab Tesla T4 only; Shonget-DMOSpeech2 at the pinned commit

calibration.grid: lambda 0 then the 1/40 ... 39/40 quantiles of the training folds' signal values over the candidate steps, ascending
calibration.constraint: training-fold mean of (output minus Step 8): capped WER at most +0.01 and similarity at least -0.01
calibration.procedure: fixed sequence from conservative to aggressive; the last lambda before the first violation

candidate_steps: Steps 4-7 always; Step 2 or 3 only if its CVf0 minus Step 8 has lower bound >= -0.02 on both ['clean', 'noisy15']; decided before the stop rules are calibrated

criteria.C1_cheaper_than_voice_swap: out-of-fold mean passes of the slow-part rule below 14 (fixed Voice-Swap)
criteria.C2_quality: out-of-fold slow-part rule minus Step 8, speaker bootstrap: capped WER upper bound <= +0.025 and similarity lower bound >= -0.01, pooled over all 360 cases
criteria.C3_pitch_variety_at_step_3: CVf0 of the handover at Step 3 minus Step 8: lower bound >= -0.02 on clean and noisy15
criteria.C4_slow_part_beats_whole_estimate: out-of-fold mean passes of the slow-part rule below those of the same rule on the whole estimate's change (the thesis's drift), calibrated identically

decision_rule: Slow-Part Handover advances to a frozen test on new speakers only if C1 to C4 all pass; otherwise it is reported as a negative result with no retuning on these data
descriptive: mean part changes per step and condition
evidence_status: development evidence on the speakers that designed EXP-020; not the thesis's frozen held-out evaluation
novelty: to our knowledge no published handover passes only part of the teacher's estimate or stops on the change of that part (targeted searches); not a full literature review
adoption: not adopted; changing the thesis method needs a dated decision record and adviser review
